question: The Kelkar Committee 2015 is related to the ________.

__
 
• Public-private partnerships involve** collaboration between** a **government agency** and the** private sector.**
 
• Public-private partnerships allow large-scale government projects.

• In this type of partnership, investments are undertaken by the private sector entity, for a** specified period of time.**
